vars.coverTitle: Get found on ChatGPT and Google search
vars.coverSub: Marketing for MSPs who can fix any server at 2am but can't explain in one sentence why a prospect should switch.
vars.whoTitle: Owners running sales, marketing and delivery at once
vars.whoIntro: Most MSPs under 25 employees have nobody in the marketing seat. That job usually falls to whoever already has the most jobs.
whoBullets: Owner-operators at 5 to 50 person MSPs, wearing sales, marketing and delivery hats.
VPs of Sales at bigger shops, hired once the founder can't close every deal alone.
A marketing coordinator, if one exists. Most sub-25 person MSPs have nobody in the seat.
Worried about keeping current clients happy while finding new ones.
Worried whether ChatGPT and Google's AI answers mention them at all.
vars.brokenTitle: Here's where MSP marketing usually breaks

brokenItems.title: The website
brokenItems.body: Built years ago, full of jargon that reads the same on every MSP site.

brokenItems.title: Proof
brokenItems.body: No client logos, no named case studies, no reviews above the fold.

brokenItems.title: Positioning
brokenItems.body: We do IT so you don't have to, said fifty different ways, no niche named.

brokenItems.title: Lead capture
brokenItems.body: A form and a phone number, nothing for someone not ready to call yet.

brokenItems.title: Sales handoff
brokenItems.body: Leads land in an inbox, not a CRM, so nothing gets nurtured or measured.

brokenItems.title: Attribution
brokenItems.body: The owner can't say which channel produced the last five signed clients.

vars.journeyTitle: How your next client actually finds you

journeySteps.title: Trigger
journeySteps.body: An outage, breach or bad renewal

journeySteps.title: Research
journeySteps.body: Google and ChatGPT, no rep yet

journeySteps.title: Decide
journeySteps.body: Contacts the one that proved it

vars.journeyTakeaway: 61% of B2B buyers prefer research without a rep, and 73% avoid suppliers who send irrelevant outreach (Gartner, 2025).

playItems.title: Named proof
playItems.body: Specific results, specific timeframes, no vague we grew their business.

playItems.title: A real niche
playItems.body: One specific pain named, not IT so you don't have to again.

playItems.title: AI visibility check
playItems.body: Does your name show up when ChatGPT is asked for a local MSP?

playItems.title: A low-commitment step
playItems.body: A guide or assessment for someone who isn't ready to call.

playItems.title: CRM routing
playItems.body: Every lead tracked, nurtured and handed back to sales with context.

playItems.title: Attribution
playItems.body: A channel-to-client chain the owner can actually read.

proofStats.l: of MSPs cite customer acquisition as their top challenge (Kaseya, 2026)
of B2B buyers prefer rep-free research (Gartner, 2025)

vars.proofTakeaway: This is an industry-wide problem, not one we invented to sell you something.
vars.plan1: Audit the site, positioning and AI visibility; confirm what counts as a qualified lead.
vars.plan2: Fix the message, add named proof, and build a next step besides just call us.
vars.plan3: Route leads into HubSpot, connect sales feedback, and publish the first proof pages.
vars.plan4: Review the visibility-to-revenue chain together and decide what earns the next scope.
vars.investmentTitle: A bounded first engagement, then a scoped plan
vars.investmentIntro: No public pricing page exists on bigorange.marketing (checked 2026-09-02). Pricing is shared in the proposal, not guessed at here.
investmentBullets: First engagement is scoped and bounded, not an open-ended retainer.
Pricing is shared in the proposal once we know your goals and current stack.
You approve every claim, badge and case study before it goes public.
We scope the next phase only after the first one proves out.
vars.closeBody: One working session to map the plan, the timeline, and what we still need from you.
